description: This file contains authorization and permission checking functions for user sessions, channels, teams, groups, and posts within the Mattermost server, implementing access control logic.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing permission and session management functions.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionTo
methods.description: Checks if a session has a specific permission based on user roles or unrestricted status.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToAndNotRestrictedAdmin
methods.description: Checks permission but denies restricted system admin access unless unrestricted.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToAny
methods.description: Checks if session has any of the provided permissions.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToTeam
methods.description: Checks if session has permission for a specific team.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToTeams
methods.description: Verifies if session has access to all specified teams.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToChannel
methods.description: Checks if session has permission to a specific channel, considering membership and team permissions.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToChannels
methods.description: Verifies if session has access to all specified channels.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToGroup
methods.description: Checks if session has permission for a specific group.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToChannelByPost
methods.description: Checks if session has permission to a channel based on a post ID.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToReadPost
methods.description: Checks if session can read a specific post.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToCategory
methods.description: Checks if session has permission to a category.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToUser
methods.description: Checks if session has permission related to a specific user.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToUserOrBot
methods.description: Checks if session has permission to a user or bot.

methods.name: HasPermissionTo
methods.description: Verifies if a user has a specific permission.

methods.name: HasPermissionToTeam
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission for a team.

methods.name: HasPermissionToChannel
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission for a channel.

methods.name: HasPermissionToChannelByPost
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission for a channel based on a post.

methods.name: HasPermissionToReadChannel
methods.description: Checks if a user can read a channel.

methods.name: HasPermissionToChannelMemberCount
methods.description: Checks if a user can view channel member count.

methods.name: SessionHasPermissionToManageBot
methods.description: Checks if session can manage a specific bot.
